(NOT APPROVED)

  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  SEPTEMBER 22, 2026

A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Torosis at 5:36 p.m., on
Tuesday, September 22, 2026, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA.

Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Caroline Torosis
  Councilmember Lana Negrete
  Councilmember Dan Hall
  Councilmember Ellis Raskin
  Councilmember Barry Snell
  Councilmember Natalya Zernitskaya

  Absent:  Mayor Pro Tem Jesse Zwick

  Also Present:  City Manager Oliver Chi
  City Attorney Heidi von Tongeln
  Interim City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

 CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 5:36 p.m., with all
  members present except Mayor Pro Tem Zwick. Councilmember Snell led
  the assemblage in the Pledge of Allegiance.

 STATEMENT OF  The City of Santa Monica Statement of Accountability (Land
 ACCOUNTABILITY  Acknowledgement) was read into the record by Councilmember
 (LAND  Zernitskaya.
 ACKNOWLEDGEMENT)

 LEVINE ACT  No Councilmembers made disclosures regarding the Levine Act (Govt Code
 DISCLOSURE  Section 84308).

 PUBLIC INPUT FOR  There were no members of the public present to comment on the Closed
 CLOSED SESSION ONLY: Session item.

 CLOSED SESSIONS  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 8:44 p.m., to consider
  Closed Sessions and returned at 9:50 p.m., with all members present, except
  Mayor Pro Tem Zwick, to report the following:

  5.A. Conference with real estate negotiator - Gov. Code § 54956.8; City
  property: 2900 & 3000 Airport Avenue, 3011 California; City
  negotiator: Oliver Chi, City Manager; persons to be negotiated

  1  September 22, 2026
   with: Larry Serota, Executive Managing Director, Transwestern,
  and Tim Katt, Gradient Holdings; under negotiation: price and
  terms of payment of lease.

  The City Attorney advised this matter was heard with no reportable action
  taken.

ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council special meeting adjourned at 9:52
  p.m.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Denise Anderson-Warren  Caroline Torosis
  Interim City Clerk  Mayor

  2  September 22, 2026
